mvp_loop.name: FPS Tactical MVP Playable Loop
steps: Launch Unity and load UrbanWarfare scene
Player spawns at start position with pistol equipped
Player moves with WASD, sprints with Shift, jumps with Space
Player aims and fires with mouse, muzzle flash and bullet holes appear
Player hits enemy, enemy takes damage and plays hit reaction
Enemy dies with death animation (fall forward/back)
Player switches weapons with 1/2/3, each has different stats
Player approaches bomb, defuse prompt appears
Player holds E, defuse progress bar fills
mvp_loop.failure_condition: If any step breaks, pipeline reports failure and triggers self-repair (max 3 attempts per stage)

description: Racing MVP from prepared car, rigged driver and prepared Unity track: materialize canonical artifacts, import through UnityClient, generate separate mechanic and UI packages, compose the race scene, compile and run Editor Play Mode.

design_doc: Reuse the gameA prison environment and rifle. Replace the original characters and animation set with the supplied FPS assets. The player clears a compact prison encounter, can open nearby doors, and wins after defeating all enemies.
Stage a short one-on-one duel inside the Sicka Yazd medieval environment. Both fighters use the supplied character assets and retargeted idle, footwork, attack, hit, and death motions.

Transform the existing countryside racing slice into a calm treasure-hunt RPG exploration demo. The player walks through the unchanged map and opens four chests. Two bats and one goblin provide non-hostile ambience around each treasure site.
